title: Elon Musk's Net Worth Drops Significantly, Loses Billions in One Day
summary: Elon Musk experienced a substantial decrease in his net worth, losing $62.7 billion in a single day. This significant financial downturn places him in a new position among the world's wealthiest individuals. The event highlights the volatility of extreme wealth and its dependence on market fluctuations.
summary_points: Elon Musk's net worth saw a decline of $62.7 billion.
The loss occurred within a single day.
This event impacts his ranking among the world's richest people.
The situation underscores the fluctuating nature of extreme wealth.

summary_points_hi: एलन मस्क की नेटवर्थ में $62.7 अरब की गिरावट देखी गई।
यह नुकसान एक ही दिन में हुआ।
